notes.title: Major FREE Content Update
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome, travelers,[/b]
We are super excited to unveil all the new content coming to Baladins! This update introduces a new region complete with a full set of quests, characters, and adventures. Additionally, there are more changes throughout the game and new features. We've also worked on optimizing the game for lower configurations and fixing bugs as much as possible. All this new content is available for free and ready right now!  

We truly hope you'll enjoy the update, and welcome to Roazay!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42145326/66e2a1a60e4076ab3b8df29daa8f70ced10b9cda.jpg[/img]

[h2]THE GATES ARE OPEN TO ROAZAY[/h2]

[b]ABOUT THE REGION[/b]
The mountains north of Gatherac serve as a frontier with the kingdom of Hobland. Once a war-torn region, it has now been peaceful for generations. A few people live there, away from the racket of Hortegarde. The two main points of interest are Roazay's Greenhouse, where monk gardeners cultivate all kinds of plants, and, of course, the gates of Belfosse, the mine-city of the nutons.

Founded by the Matagots in the mountains near Hollow Mount, Roazay is a spiritual and religious landmark for Gatherac. It provides a sanctuary for outcasts, misfits, and loners from across the country.
The village is built around a circle of stones raised centuries ago, the creators of which remain unknown. However, the Matagots feel a profound connection to the world of the dead here and frequently honor the four gods through rituals, particularly Gruïd. An enduring sense of peace and tranquility envelops the village. The residents speak softly, avoid arguments, and do not engage in fights. Tents and small stone houses are constructed near the lake and around the village's largest structure: the Monastery of the Garden.

The Matagots nurture and tend to a flower garden, safeguarding rare botanical species. They utilize these plants in rituals and for crafting potions and medicines. Those devoted to caring for this place are known as the Gardeners, a semi-monastic order. It is said that there is no wound or illness the Gardeners cannot heal. While the order was originally comprised mostly of Matagots, now individuals from all backgrounds are part of the Gardeners.
Pilgrims travel here from all over Gatherac—and even from beyond its borders—but the journey to the mountain is arduous and fraught with challenges and peril.

[h2]NEW FEATURES![/h2][list]
[*] [b]Travelling Merchants:[/b] Endlessly walking the road and roaming from village to village, the traveling merchants join Baladins to bring you new items and buy & sell opportunities. Get your timing right if you want to cross their path! 
[*] [b]Hidden Character: [/b]A suspicious little character is now hiding in the lands of Gatherac. Time to play hide & seek! Find them, and they'll greet you with a culture test and potential rewards! 
[/list]
[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2][list]
[*] Get ready to meet the wonderful new NPCs! 
[*] What is going on around here? They need your help to solve a seemingly insurmountable issue.
[*] Plus, you'll find a delightful variety of new items to discover!
[*] Discover new ways to solve existing quests by using your class actions throughout the land.[/list]
[previewyoutube=sre_DCzssKY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]BUG FIXES & MISC[/h2]

[b]Network rework[/b]
- We changed the network plug-in used for the game. It's mostly invisible, but now you must share a code with your friends to connect with one another. This results in some changes to the title menu UI: a local/online menu and a lobby code menu.

[b]Debug[/b]
- Fixed potential event desynchronization when switching event during another event
- Fixed a dice roll sound that was playing in a loop
- Fixed ending loop event desynchronization
- Fixed credits music continuing when returnin main menu
- Fixed loading issues with the most recent campaign when a campaign is deleted
- Fixed some french texts that were displaying the info "NEEDS UPDATE"
- Fixed some boards sounds continuing durring end loop event

[b]Misc[/b]
- Added a splash screen when the game launches and while game assets are loading
- Added music during the recap board
- Added music in the character selection screen when restarting a loop
- Changed the main game font
- Implemented optimizations: reduced the size of some sprites and textures, added LODs, fixed memory leaks, loaded more assets at game startup instead of during gameplay (resulting in only one loading per game session), improved launch speed to make it slightly faster.

[h2]THE ART BOOK GETS AN UPGRADE[/h2]
It's nothing less than 27 pages of creatives arts, doodles and more to discover unsaid backstories as well as the processus of creation behind the characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42145326/10938ba6a2b3b6a42511851de1486bcd12285e0a.png[/img]

[h2]AGAIN THANKS FOR YOUR SUPPORT[/h2]
This is our biggest update yet: 20% more content, more adventure, more Baladins! If you've enjoyed the journey so far, a quick review would mean the world to us. It helps us more than you know! Thanks and happy questing!

notes.title: Big game update! v 1.1 LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Steam players!
[/h1]
It's been a little over a month now that Baladins has been out and seeing the response it’s received since has been a thrill!

We’ve read through all your comments, Discord messages, emails, Steam forums, and more; and we’ve worked on fixing the biggest issues that our community has been facing, as well as making some changes that you have been requesting.

Here are the major points that have been raised so far:
 [list]
[*]  [b]Multiplayer[/b]: The people demand Remote Play Together 
[*]  [b]Save system[/b]: Once-a-loop saves is too little.
[*]  [b]Gamepad[/b]: There is a need for better precision and UX improvements.
[*]  [b]Online[/b]: Disconnection issues
[/list]
Our dev & QA team have been hard at work, and we're very happy to present you all with this big new update 🥳

Here’s a breakdown of what it includes:
✅  The people have spoken, and we have listened: Remote Play Together is now available.
✅  New Save System: you can now save the game once per (in-game) week
✅  Gamepad support has been improved, and we’ve added a reticule.
✅  A lot of debugs have been made on disconnection issues.

Your feedback has been immensely helpful and encouraging to us, and we hope this update will make Baladins as enjoyable as we always wanted it to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42145326/d9223bd866d253942a220d92b7ff9f71ce45be4d.png[/img]

[b][h1]Patch Notes details:[/h1]
[/b]
[b]Features:
[/b][list]
[*] New Save System: The run will save at the beginning of each week. Every quest statues, rumor, and random encounter will save, as well all class stats, inventories, and locations. You can resume at any later point, alone or with the rest of your party, right where you left off. Even if the rest of you party does not join back at the same time, missing classes that were saved will return at the end of the loop and their progression will be acknowledged.
[*] End your loop: You can now end your loop at anytime by simply going to “Settings” and selecting “End the Loop”. If everyone in the party approves, you will directly go to confront Colobra.
[*] Controller: We have added a cursor to controllers on the board. No more tedious searching!
[*] Remote Play: After testing the feature to the best of our abilities, we are happy to announce that Remote Play Together is now available!
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Several save bugs have been fixed.
[*] We resolved a bug that desynchronized random draws, which in turn would desynchronize the entire run.
[*] Items kept after a run are now really kept - for real now!
[*] We solved dice roll autowin/autolose modifier synchronization.
[*] Several typos in the French version have been fixed.
[*] Several quests have been fixed.
[*] Camera can now pan lower in Mouliac, allowing better/easier selection of the guild hall.
[*] Crown is properly displayed during a vote.
[/list]

notes.title: 🛠 Patch notes: v1.0.14
notes.notes:
Hey troublemakers, 

🛠 A new patch has been pushed, fixing a few issues on the game. Thanks to everyone reporting the problems encountered. It's very helpful! 🛠

What's new?
- Fixed a blocking bug happening when leaving [i]Colobra's mouth[/i] on a client session (not hosting) without any active save 
- Now saving the game when entering the [i]Colobra's mouth[/i], preventing progression loss if there is a disconnection at this point
- Now preventing calorie bar animation from blocking the dialogue. A timer of 5s skips the animation if it's too long.
- Fixed the game not starting when playing on an OS with [i]Turkish culture[/i]
- Now forcing the client to show the [i]Settings menu[/i] when the host opens it during the game introduction (before giving the crate to Sopheline).
- It is now possible to loop through the [i]Player menu tabs[/i] using the gamepad triggers
- Fixed  a localization issue in the [i]Join friend[/i] menu
- Fixed some missing French localization
- Fixed a [i]Quest log[/i] desynchronization issue happening if a client gets disconnected during the end of the loop

New patches & updates are to come in the next days,
Good days and play well!

The Seed by Seed team

notes.title: Baladins has a RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,
We're thrilled to announce it, the day has come: 

[b]🌟 Baladins is releasing on Steam May 15th 2024🌟 [/b]

[previewyoutube=woaoVQTXOaw;full][/previewyoutube]

Traverse the four regions of Gatherac, fulfill countless quests, resolve townsfolks' disputes, and encounter many quirky NPCs on your journey to appease Colobra 🐲 , the time-eating dragon who's awoken from its deep slumber.

Choose from five distinct classes and gather your team of up to four baladins (local and online co-op available), and set off on your journey. Take turns completing different tasks like brewing potions🧙  or taking a nap 💤 - but make sure to make the most of your 6 week loop, for Colobra will be waiting to judge whether you have managed to satiate its hunger, or if you must be sent back to start your journey anew!⏳ 

Have a wonderful day, and see you on the release day o/

- 🐲 The 'end turn' button is now displayed in the locations UI when you don't have action/movement points left.

- Overall UI optimization.
- Tonneline has been buffed.

Good day to all of you! We have updated the demo of the game with some minor fixes, quality of life and a whole new trad to french! Have fun.

The game is now playable in French !

[b]Balancing:[/b]
- Alda's and Filomena's challenges are now subject to dice rolls to harmonize all behaviors in the game.
- Fixed the stolen wine questline : you couldn't meet the sleeping bandit if you did not tell the bandits about the secret passage in the castle. There was also a bug allowing you to steal from the bandit and receive nothing.
- The base difficulty threshold of all dice rolls has been raised a bit (from 7 to 8 )
- Added a system to prevent being trapped in a bad luck loop : the hard challenges with the salamanders are automatic successes if you try enough times.
